item.description:
New

  • Temporarily hide the Dynamic Island to reach the menu bar icons it covers: hover over its wings for a moment or press a global shortcut, and it comes back after the pointer leaves the menu bar. Turn on either trigger under Settings › Display › Temporary Hide.
  • Switch the Claude Code account used on this Mac from Melora: choose "Set Active" on a saved Claude subscription account in the menu panel or in Settings › Models & Subscriptions.
  • Copy a ready-made prompt that asks your agent to add a custom provider, from Settings › Models & Subscriptions.

Improved

  • Dynamic Island avatars and the Low Power Mode transition now follow Reduce Motion consistently.

Fixed

  • Fix sluggish response and sustained high CPU usage when many unread attention items were being synced to a paired iPhone.
  • Fix Codex reset announcements being checked late after a refresh was cancelled.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
